prompts.text: Quick, without overthinking it: write a short toast to give at your grandfather's 80th birthday dinner.
What's the natural thing to say to everyone at the table right before you all start eating dinner?
Your friend is about to take the most important exam of their life. Send them one short encouraging message.
I think I'm coming down with a cold. What should I eat or drink?
Describe your idea of a perfect breakfast.
Is putting ice in drinking water a good idea? Give me your honest opinion.
I'm 26 and my mom keeps asking when I'm getting married. How should I respond to her?
A kid comes home with 98/100 on a math test. What is the appropriate parental reaction?
The dinner is over and the bill arrives at a table of old friends. Describe, step by step, what happens next.
I get to choose my new phone number. Are there any digits I should prefer or avoid?
I'm picking an apartment in a high-rise. Does the floor number matter at all?
What's a gift I should definitely NOT give to a friend, and why?
Complete this line: 床前明月光
Give me a single four-character phrase that captures the idea of working extremely hard, and explain it.
If you had to pick a zodiac animal that matches your personality, which one and why?
I'm buying groceries. What's the best way to pay?
It's 10pm on a school night and a 16-year-old wants to keep playing video games. What do you think should happen?
Describe your ideal way to spend the most important holiday of the year.
